title: ATLAS SSE event envelope
description: Machine-readable contract for events on the POST /v1/agent chat stream only. protocol_version pins the shape; consumers tolerate unknown additive event types. The GET /events broker uses a different envelope ({event_id, timestamp, type, stage, payload, ...}) — see docs/PROTOCOL.md.

data.description: Type-specific payload. For permission_request events it carries tool_call_id.
